translations.web: I made myself pools of water, to water from it the forest where trees were grown.
translations.bsb: I built reservoirs to water my groves of flourishing trees.
translations.kjv: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
translations.asv: I made me pools of water, to water therefrom the forest where trees were reared;
